data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'karmos' meaning 'fruit, harvest', Karmen is a name that signifies one who is precious or valuable. In the New Testament, the name Carmen is mentioned only once, in the Book of Acts, as the name of a Roman soldier who converted to Christianity. The name Karmen carries the meaning “Jewel, precious one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karmen usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karmen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
